lead.title: Muna Therapeutics: oral TREM2 modulator clears Phase 1 in Alzheimer's, Phase 2 planned for early 2027
lead.deck: MNA-001, an oral small molecule that strengthens microglia rather than targeting amyloid, reaches the cerebrospinal fluid with clean tolerability, and some age-associated biomarkers in older volunteers moved toward younger levels. The Danish biotech released no cohort sizes or doses: an early signal to watch ahead of its next round.

milestone.title: Alnylam: brezosiran (RNAi) cuts mutant huntingtin in CSF by 60-64% in Huntington's disease
milestone.summary: Phase 1b data presented in Krakow: dose-dependent reduction at 3 months, up to 83% in one patient, via the C16 conjugate platform targeting exon 1 of HTT mRNA. A placebo-controlled study is planned for 2027.
milestone.why: Evidence that conjugated RNAi can reach the brain, a building block for CNS oligo startups. Caution: Roche's tominersen also lowered mHTT without clinical benefit.

deal.thesis: Menarini (via Stemline) takes worldwide rights to GIM-621, a still preclinical oral immunotherapy whose target and mechanism are undisclosed. A European pharma bet on Georgiamune's oral Treg platform, funded by a $92.7M Series B.

brefsEurope.title: Arctic Therapeutics raises $21.5M to take autoimmune programs to the clinic
brefsEurope.summary: Oversubscribed round led by Pekron, Kaldbakur and Landvættir with Sanos. Pipeline: AT-001 (HCCAA; Phase 2a in mild Alzheimer's), AT-002 (uveitis), AT-003, AT-004 (acne, Phase 2a completed).

brefsEurope.title: EQT-led consortium to take Qiagen private at €10.8B enterprise value, €46.50 per share in cash
brefsEurope.summary: Public offer at a 40.3% premium; consortium includes Luxinva (ADIA) and CPP Investment Board Europe. Closing expected mid-2027. A major comparable for life-science tools and diagnostics.

brefsEurope.title: Sensorion names Peter Weber Chief Medical Officer effective November 2
brefsEurope.summary: Previously at Decibel Therapeutics and Regeneron in inner-ear gene therapy, he prepares the clinical development of SENS-601 in GJB2-related hearing loss.

brefsEurope.title: Orano Med names Matthew Fyfe Chief Scientific Officer
brefsEurope.summary: Former CSO of Outrun Therapeutics, he leads research on lead-212 therapies across France and the US (announced October 19).

brefsEurope.title: Mikael Dolsten, former Pfizer CSO, joins the board of Maxion Therapeutics
brefsEurope.summary: Independent non-executive director; Maxion raised $72M in 2025.

brefsIntl.title: Roche licenses ZW209 (DLL3 trispecific T-cell engager) from Zymeworks: $55M upfront, up to $813M
brefsIntl.summary: ZW209 binds DLL3 on tumour cells and CD3/CD28 on T cells for lung cancer; Phase 1a started, with high-single-digit to mid-teen royalties.

brefsIntl.title: Gilead takes PepStar's oral IL-23 receptor inhibitor for $1.3B upfront
brefsIntl.summary: HCXT-2001, an oral macrocyclic peptide, targets IBD and psoriasis; closing expected by quarter-end. A pricing comparable for oral peptides.

word.definition: A bispecific antibody that grabs a T cell with one arm and a diseased cell with the other, so the T cell kills its target.

parts.label: CD3 arm
parts.role: grabs and activates the T cell

parts.label: Antigen arm
parts.role: recognizes the target cell (e.g. DLL3, CD19)

parts.label: Co-stimulation (optional)
parts.role: a third CD28 arm helps T cells proliferate and survive

how.t: One arm binds the tumour cell, the other binds CD3 on the T cell.
The T cell is brought into contact with the target, independently of MHC I or classic co-stimulation.
The T cell releases perforin and granzymes that trigger apoptosis; cytokine release syndrome (CRS) is the typical adverse effect.

word.why: An off-the-shelf alternative to CAR-T, already validated (blinatumomab, tarlatamab) and booming: Roche-Zymeworks this week, UCB-Candid (up to $2.2B) and Sanofi-Kali in 2026, with expansion into autoimmunity.
